post.title: How Costco really makes money
post.ig:
Costco sells a $1.50 hot dog. So how does it make billions?

Fiscal 2026: $297.2B in sales, $9.23B in profit, because markups are kept low.
Membership fees alone: $5.91B, equal to about two-thirds of that profit.
84.1 million paid members, and 89.8% renew worldwide.

Source: Costco fiscal 2026 results (Sep 24, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
